title: Moroccan Tagine Stew
description: A hearty vegetarian stew inspired by the flavors of Morocco, made with a variety of vegetables and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Lamb broth (or vegetable broth as a substitute)

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the bottom of a large clay tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the carrots and red bell peppers and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, olives, chickpeas, tagine spice blend, vegetable broth, and lamb broth (or substitute).
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
